{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to customers who converted
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Count converted customers with invalid age (-1)
invalid_age_count = len(converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] == -1])

# Filter out invalid age entries (customer_age == -1)
valid_age_df = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_age_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print key counts and mean
print(f"Number of customers who converted: {len(converted_df)}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with invalid age (-1): {invalid_age_count}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_age_df)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age}")"}
